formal_statement.description: Must elaborate to at least one verifiable declaration. Complete proofs are accepted; a sorry placeholder is not required. Invalid or target-free statements skip candidate elaboration.

content.description: Elaborated independently in the fixed Mathlib environment; target dependencies must satisfy the strict axiom and sorry policy.

use_def_eq.description: Compare elaborated expressions by definitional equality, including optParam Nat 60 versus Nat. False selects structural expression equality after universe-parameter normalization, not source-text equality.

ignore_imports.description: Both inputs use the preloaded Mathlib environment. Requested import module names are ignored; no requested module is dynamically loaded.

timeout_seconds.description: Finite total queue-and-execution budget. Omission uses the deployment default (600 seconds unless configured); the deployment maximum is enforced by the server.
